title: Future Value Annuity
body:
Themba deposits R2 500 at the end of every month into a savings account that earns 8.4% per annum, compounded monthly.

Calculate the total amount in the account after 5 years.

Future Value Annuity Formula: $F = x \cdot \frac{(1+i)^n - 1}{i}$
